tasks.label: build-libstreamplace
tasks.command: PLATFORM=${config:streamplace.buildPlatform}; PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$(pwd)/build-$PLATFORM/lib/pkgconfig:$(pwd)/build-$PLATFORM/lib/gstreamer-1.0/pkgconfig:$(pwd)/build-$PLATFORM/meson-uninstalled CGO_LDFLAGS='-Wl,--allow-shlib-undefined' LD_LIBRARY_PATH=build-$PLATFORM/lib go build -tags mainnet -o build-$PLATFORM/libstreamplace ./cmd/libstreamplace/...
